notes: The booklet has one set (9469-1), with two minifigures, Gandalf and Frodo. Pages 21-24 are an advert, a minifig catalogue and a survey, not builds.

L3 (two groups): this is real and I am keeping it. Frodo is a separate minifigure (page 3, and standing beside the cart on page 19). The booklet never attaches him to the cart or horse. Joining him would invent a connection. Gandalf is joined to the seat plate, so he is part of the cart group.

L1 (4211214, 600540): these look like artifacts of the parts-page text. Page 20 shows 4211214 once, as a single 'Plate 2x8 dark brown', and it is used once, in step 4 (b22). The parts page's footer fragment '1x 4211214 1x 4598334 1x 6005402' repeats three labels already listed above it and shows no extra pieces. The check's '600540' is a truncated form of 6005402, the horse, which is listed once and appears once as lego-6005402 (b13). Both counts match the booklet's pictures, so I kept them and added no piece the steps do not use.

Single-use port rule: plates have numbered stud ports, so each join uses its own port. Attachments to the dark brown 2x8 plate b22 follow stud order as an approximation of the real stud positions. The catalogue 2x4 plate 4114309 exposes only one stud, so the seat group (b52-b56) is chained rather than all sitting on the one 2x4.
Each of the four posts (step 12) attaches to a different stud of a side panel: panel A studs 3 and 4, panel B studs 3 and 4.

The hinge plates in steps 6, 8 and 9 are assumed to pair as follows: tailgate (b46, b47) on the rear pair b25/b26, side panel A (b39, b40) on b31/b32, and side panel B (b41, b42) on b35/b36. The booklet does not show which pair goes where.

The white cone b62 sits on top of the yellow rod b64. The catalogue cone has no port compatible with a rod, so that join has null ports. The barrel has three separate top openings for the yellow rod, grey rod and snake. The carrot rests on side panel B, but which panel is a guess.

Gandalf's head, beard and cape are chained head-beard-cape-torso, as on page 3. Heads 6003296/6003235 and seat plates 4219726/4566688 are assigned by appearance, because the parts page shows no names.
